responsibility: Implements the AVX-512ER intrinsic header for exponential and reciprocal approximation instructions provided by the AVX-512 Exponential and Reciprocal subset. It exposes masked and rounded forms of exp2a23, rcp28, and rsqrt28 operations for packed and scalar single/double precision, using inline wrappers or macros around GCC builtins and bundling the default-rounding convenience macros that distinguish this header from more general AVX-512 math headers.
